Job Title: Regional Vice President, Enterprise Account Management

Location: United States, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Revenue is complex, and clarity is rare. Our mission at Salesloft is to transform revenue complexity into clear, decisive action for every team driving growth.

We’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, where humans and AI work together to make confident decisions based on real signals. Thousands of customers run on our platforms every day, which gives us Revenue Context: a view into what happens in a deal, when, and with what outcome.

Our vision is a future where revenue growth is predictable and the teams driving it are unstoppable. If you want to help build it, alongside people who Move as One and let Evidence over Ego guide the work, we’d love to meet you.

THE OPPORTUNITY
Lead one of our highest-performing enterprise teams as it shows customers why a Predictive Revenue System is the way to run pipeline, forecast and growth.

As our Regional Vice President, Enterprise Account Management, you’ll lead 6 to 8 seasoned enterprise sellers who own our largest customer relationships. At Salesloft, we connect pipeline generation, deal progression and forecasting in one closed loop through our Predictive Revenue System, and you’ll help your team bring that story to senior revenue and technology leaders. In your first six months you will:

• Keep a strong team on the field: assess the talent, decide where to upskill and where to add, and keep the team’s momentum through a rapidly changing market.

• Shift the conversations your team has: engage the executives who own the revenue problem and the leaders who own the AI and go-to-market strategy, and sharpen how we win against build-it-yourself and frontier-model alternatives.

• Grow the base: lift win rates and velocity on six- and seven-figure expansion opportunities, and open more cross-sell conversations with customers who don’t yet use us for their entire revenue lifecycle process.

HOW YOU’LL WORK HERE

• Move as One: You’ll work daily with SEs, Customer Success, RevOps, Product and Marketing, and share credit for the wins. Our sellers own the renewal and the growth, so you’ll help them mobilize the whole company behind each customer.

• Evidence over Ego: You’ll inspect pipeline and forecast using real buyer signals, not gut feel, and say so when the data changes your mind.

• Lead from the Front: You’ll coach in the work, stay close to key deals without taking them over, and take ownership early, with or without a title that says you should.

• Make Your Mark: You’ll shape how we sell the Predictive Revenue System to enterprise buyers, not just run the existing playbook.

• Customer-Inspired: You’ll turn what customers tell you into what we build and say, including why they choose to build, buy or consolidate.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
You’re a sales leader who makes experienced sellers better, builds trust with executives, and stays close to the business without taking it over. You’re as comfortable inspecting a forecast as you are coaching a hard conversation. If you want to learn more, do more, and become more, this is your next move.

YOU’LL BRING

• A record of leading enterprise teams to results: Consistent quota attainment across 5+ years of leading enterprise sellers, with a team where several reps reach top-performer status.

• Hands-on leadership of complex deals: You’ve guided large, multi-stakeholder deals (six to seven figures) through renewal and expansion, and know how to add value in the room without taking over from the rep.

• Coaching that changes behavior and raises the bar: You coach to specific, observable selling behaviors (discovery, value articulation, deal strategy, executive conversations) and to MEDDPICC discipline in deal qualification and inspection. You do this through call reviews, role-play and regular 1:1s, and you hold sellers accountable for the change. You see results in win rates, deal velocity and pipeline quality, and you hire coachable sellers who raise the bar for the team.

• A forecast leaders can trust: You inspect pipeline using buyer evidence, stage discipline and conversion data, and you can explain what drove a miss.

• Executive and cross-functional presence: You can build a business case with a CRO or CFO and align SEs, Customer Success, RevOps and Product behind a customer.

• Comfort leading through change: You’ve kept a team focused and performing through shifts in product, comp, territory or market.

IT’S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE

• Experience selling revenue technology (sales engagement, conversation intelligence, forecasting or revenue operations) to CROs, RevOps and Sales Enablement leaders

• Experience leading sellers through a combined renewal and growth motion, not new business alone

• Fluency with AI tools and workflows, and experience selling to the leaders who own AI strategy and the build-versus-buy decision

• Experience competing against internally built tools or displacing incumbents in enterprise accounts

THE TEAM
You’ll lead 6 to 8 seasoned enterprise sellers on one of the strongest teams in our enterprise segment, with several already at or pacing toward President’s Club. The team owns both retention and growth across our largest customers, at a time when Salesloft is changing how we sell and who we sell to. It’s a great place to grow: you’ll have a high-performing team, real influence on how we go to market, and the backing of leadership and enablement to do it well.

BENEFITS:

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a competitive, holistic benefits program designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health at every stage of your life and career. For full details on coverage options, wellness incentives, and perks, explore our benefits overview at  https://salesloftbenefits.com/

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Some roles can’t be filled with a standard search. Talent Discovery is the part of MongoDB’s Talent Acquisition team that finds and builds relationships with the people we want to hire. As a Talent Sourcer on the Talent Discovery team, you’ll work on our hardest-to-fill, niche, and business-critical roles, and build talent pipelines for the roles we hire for again and again. This work is deep research and real conversations: you’ll dig into adjacent markets and unconventional talent pools, find people who aren’t looking, and earn their interest in MongoDB.

You’ll partner with recruiters and hiring managers to understand what a search really needs, build a targeted plan for finding it, and hand off strong, well-documented slates and pipelines as candidates move into formal interviews.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

In this role, you will

  • Own and drive the sourcing plan. Turn hiring needs into a clear search strategy, align stakeholders on the target profile, and lead the approach from there
  • Map talent markets. Use tools like Gem, SeekOut, LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, and X-ray search to research scarce talent pools and track talent movement, including competitors, adjacent markets, and emerging companies and geographies
  • Reach out to candidates with intent. Write personal, informed outreach that reflects each person’s background and what would motivate them, not keyword matching
  • Build long-term relationships. Engage and nurture passive candidates over time, so MongoDB is top of mind when the right role opens
  • Qualify beyond the resume. Run conversations that surface what motivates each candidate, and keep them informed and interested as searches progress.
  • Hand off with full context. Present qualified slates and pipelines to recruiters and hiring managers, including each candidate’s background, motivations, fit, and history
  • Share what you learn. Bring market insight back to the recruiting team, such as where talent is and what competitors are doing
  • Keep the CRM/ATS clean. Keep search progress, pipeline health, and relationship history visible to the whole team

You are someone who has

  • 2 years of experience in sourcing, research, or recruiting, ideally including niche or hard-to-fill searches
  • Sharp research instincts and the confidence to take an unclear hiring need and shape it into a clear search strategy
  • A track record of engaging passive candidates and sustaining those relationships over time
  • Working knowledge of sourcing and market-intelligence tools (e.g., Gem, SeekOut, LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, X-ray search, or equivalents)
  • Experience using AI in sourcing and research, and good judgment about where it helps and where human judgment has to lead
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to build trust with someone who isn’t looking for a job
  • Strong attention to data hygiene and follow-through
  • A collaborative mindset: you’ll work closely with recruiters and hiring managers, and you want to see your work turn into hires

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. Metabolic health is a core, cross-cutting component of this program. Weight, insulin resistance, and cardiometabolic risk are central to outcomes across every journey we support, from ovulatory function and preconception readiness to menopausal symptom burden and long-term cardiovascular and bone health. You should expect metabolic assessment and management to be a routine part of your visits, and clinicians comfortable prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists, within clinical protocols are especially encouraged to apply.

This is a flexible, part-time contractor engagement of approximately 5-40 hours per week, with a target commitment of 10-15 hours per week. 

What You’ll Own 

In this role, you will:

• Provide virtual consultations (video and/or phone) within your area(s) of expertise, including assessment, diagnosis, treatment planning, and ongoing management of menopausal, fertility, and related hormonal and metabolic concerns.

• Apply current ACOG, ASRM, and The Menopause Society guidelines with individualized, shared decision-making.

• Expanded your state licensure coverage in line with program needs, supporting broader member access.

• Contributed to chart audits, case reviews, and clinical protocol refinement as the telemedicine program scales.

• For clinicians practicing in the menopause specialty: MSCP certification from The Menopause Society, or certification actively in progress with a clear completion plan.

• Familiarity with ACOG, ASRM, and The Menopause Society guidelines.

• Prior telemedicine experience (preferred), with comfort managing visits entirely in a virtual environment and a strong virtual presence that supports shared decision-making over video and phone.

• Proficiency with telehealth technologies, including video platforms, secure messaging, electronic prescribing, and EHR/clinical documentation tools.

• Familiarity with HIPAA and applicable telemedicine privacy, security, and regulatory requirements, along with a HIPAA-compliant home workspace and reliable internet.

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

• Clinical experience spanning both early fertility and menopause, enabling flexible coverage across member journeys.

• Experience working in a dedicated menopause clinic, fertility center, or comparable specialty program.

• Familiarity with early fertility workup, including AMH testing, ovulation induction, and preconception optimization, with appropriate escalation to in-person ART evaluation.

• Experience prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists (titration, side-effect management, monitoring, and discontinuation planning); obesity medicine training or ABOM certification is a significant advantage.

Why This Role Matters 

Carrot's telemedicine clinic is one of the most direct ways members experience our care. Every virtual visit shapes how members navigate some of the most personal moments of their lives, from trying to conceive to managing menopause. The clinicians in this network are the face of that experience, and the quality of their judgment, communication, and documentation determines whether members receive care they trust.

This role also anchors Carrot's clinical point of view that metabolic health is inseparable from reproductive and hormonal health. As the telemedicine program scales across states and journeys, the clinicians who join this network will directly expand access to guideline-aligned, whole-person care for members who often cannot find it locally.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. To further this important mission, we're building our Accounting team in Bangalore Finance and are looking for someone to help us scale for the future in a fast-paced environment.

Role Summary

We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and tech-forward Corporate Accounting Analyst to join our fast-paced corporate accounting team. In this role, you will play a critical part in managing General Ledger (GL) activities, ensuring accurate close processes, and driving accounting precision across specialized technical areas, including debt, prepaids, intercompany transactions, and lease accounting .

The ideal candidate holds a Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification, possesses 4–6 years of progressive accounting experience, and brings a modern, tech-enabled mindset—specifically the ability to leverage AI tools, automation, and advanced analytics to streamline workflows and solve complex accounting problems in a rapidly evolving environment.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (F&S, FinOps, Tax, Operations) to ensure accurate accounting treatment for complex transactions.

  • Utilize advanced data tools to process large volumes of financial data accurately under tight deadliness.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Education & Certification: Chartered Accountant (CA) or equivalent professional accounting designation is mandatory.

  • AI & Tech Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to adopt and operate AI tools (e.g., generative AI for documentation/analysis, workflow automation software, advanced ERP modules) to optimize accounting tasks.

  • Fast-Paced Adaptability: Ability to prioritize effectively, meet tight monthly/quarterly closing deadlines, and thrive in an agile, dynamic environment.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of (or experience in) the technology or payments industry
  • Big4 working experience
  • Oracle suite
  • Hubble and SQL

Headquarters: Remote / San Francisco, CA / New York, NY / Raleigh, NC 

The Team + The Role

Software is being written faster than ever, and AI coding agents are accelerating how teams build and ship. Novus is Pendo's answer to what happens after software ships: helping fast-moving teams understand what is actually happening in their products and where to focus next. This is a new product, in a new category, for an audience Pendo has not traditionally sold to before: product engineers and application owners building AI-native software.

As Lead Product Marketing Manager for Novus, you are the marketing lead and GTM owner for the product. You own the narrative, positioning, demand strategy, community presence, launch moments, and early commercial outcomes end to end. This is a 0-to-1 role for someone who can write the playbook, execute it hands-on, and drive clarity across product, sales, marketing, and leadership.

This is a remote role in the US. We have offices in San Francisco, CA, Raleigh, NC, or New York, NY.

What this looks like day-to-day

• Narrative and positioning: Own the messaging, positioning, and talk tracks for Novus, including the breakthrough narrative, category story, and positioning documentation. Keep product, sales, marketing, and leadership aligned as the product and market evolve.

• End-to-end GTM ownership: Build and run the full go-to-market plan across audience targeting, channel strategy, campaign strategy, sales readiness, launch moments, and success metrics. Own the outcomes rather than handing strategy off to another team.

• Top-of-funnel and conversion: Partner with revenue marketing to define the acquisition channel mix, run campaigns, and drive early-access signups. Connect demand activity to free-to-paid conversion and early commercial signals.

• Community building: Build Novus' presence where builders already spend time, including developer forums, social channels, influencer relationships, and event-driven activation. Earn trust with audiences that are skeptical of traditional marketing.

• PLG motion: Partner with product and growth to design self-serve onboarding, activation flows, and freemium-to-paid conversion paths. Use data and feedback to improve how users discover, try, activate, and expand with Novus.

• Novus and Pendo positioning: Define how Novus and Pendo exist together in the market. Shape the path for customers moving from fast-moving AI-native teams into more complex product organizations.

• Sales and partner enablement: Build the materials, messaging, and proof points that help sales and partner teams have credible conversations with product engineers. Translate the product for a buyer that is meaningfully different from Pendo's traditional PM audience.

• Metrics and commercial impact: Work with revenue marketing to define and track the metrics that connect Novus activity to pipeline and early revenue outcomes. Focus on activation, free-to-paid conversion, marketing-sourced ARR, and other signals that show whether the motion is working.

Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Product Marketing Directors don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.

You're AI-curious - genuinely.

You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.

Must-haves

• 7+ years of marketing experience with real ownership of positioning and narrative for a product or category at the individual contributor level.

• Proven ability to drive a launch, repositioning, or category story end to end, including the writing and strategic thinking behind the work.

• Strong content instincts, with the ability to create crisp narratives, sharp positioning documents, and launch materials that audiences actually engage with.

• Active, practical fluency with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar, with evidence that AI has meaningfully changed how you work and what you ship.

• High bias to action, with a track record of shipping, gathering feedback, iterating, and filling gaps without waiting for perfect information.

• Ability to translate technical depth into clear, compelling messaging without oversimplifying a novel product.

• Strong cross-functional influence with product, sales, marketing, and leadership stakeholders, especially in environments where you need to drive alignment without direct authority.

• Experience with PLG motions, including self-serve acquisition, freemium conversion, activation, or community-led distribution.

• Credibility with developer or builder audiences, including an understanding of how technical users discover, evaluate, and build trust in new tools.

Nice-to-haves

• Hands-on experience building community among developers or other technical builder audiences.

• Technical fluency from building software or working closely enough with engineers to understand codebases, pull requests, and deploy cycles.

• Experience in product analytics, instrumentation, observability, developer tools, open source, or AI coding tools.

• Growth-hacking experience in an early-stage or 0-to-1 product environment.

About Pendo

Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. Our mission is to improve society's experience with software. Come join one of the fastest-growing startups, supported by best-in-class institutions like Battery Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital and Meritech.

Pendo Core Values: Bias to Act, Hone Your Craft, The Team is Pendo, and Maniacal Focus.
